name: Bima USBD
oneLiner: USBD is Bima's Bitcoin-backed CDP stablecoin minted from overcollateralized BTC LST vaults under Liquity-style mechanics with a USDC/USDP/GUSD PSM.
collateral: Bitcoin liquid staking/restaking derivatives and other approved BTC wrappers deposited into BIMA vaults; the Peg Stability Module can also hold approved stablecoins such as USDC, USDP, and GUSD for peg operations
pegMechanism: Liquity-style overcollateralized vaults with a 150% minimum collateral ratio; USBD can be redeemed permissionlessly for $1 of BTC-denominated collateral from the lowest-ratio vaults with a fee of coreRate + 75 bps; a Peg Stability Module adds near-1:1 USDC/USDP/GUSD swaps

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: USBD resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

reserves.name: Bitcoin LSTs / LRTs and approved BTC wrappers

mintAuthority.summary: USBD is a Liquity-v1-fork CDP minted via BorrowerOperations against overcollateralized BTC LST/LRT vaults (150% MCR); BimaCore governs collateral types, debt ceilings, and risk parameters, and a PSM adds near-1:1 USDC/USDP/GUSD swaps.

controls.label: BIMA BorrowerOperations (Liquity-v1 fork)
controls.capDescription: Mint gated by per-collateral debt ceilings and a 150% minimum collateral ratio enforced by the TroveManager/Factory.
controls.evidence: BIMA docs and mainnet-addresses page describe a Liquity-fork stack (BorrowerOperations, Factory, TroveManager, SortedTroves, StabilityPool) minting the USBD DebtToken against locked BTC collateral.

controls.label: BimaCore governance / parameter admin
controls.evidence: BimaCore is the central access-control hub; governance can add collateral types and adjust debt ceilings, stability fees, and collateral ratios. Owner/admin not disclosed or shown renounced in the docs.

review.evidence: USBD is minted permissionlessly by users via the BIMA BorrowerOperations contract against overcollateralized BTC LST vaults under Liquity-v1 mechanics, with BimaCore governing risk parameters and a PSM for stable swaps. Identical-address multichain deployments mint locally; no bridge mint is documented. Owner renouncement is not asserted.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Liquity-fork mechanism and contract addresses confirmed from BIMA docs; the BimaCore owner/admin and any timelock/multisig were not independently read on-chain, so immutability cannot be claimed.
unresolvedQuestions: Read BimaCore owner/guardian on Etherscan to determine whether parameter/upgrade authority is renounced, timelocked, or held by an EOA/multisig before raising confidence.
